strategies.name: Detection of Remote System Information Discovery

analytics.name: Analytic 1919
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies remote Windows system-information queries using WMI/CIM, WinRM, PowerShell remoting, or equivalent management tooling where the command names a non-local target and the account/source is outside the approved management baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

tuning.description: IP allowlist of legitimate sources for device identification queries.
Accounts with documented system administration responsibilities.
Time window within which multiple enumeration commands are considered a systematic reconnaissance sequence.

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
log_sources.channel: EventCode=1 remote-management command (for example wmic /node, winrs, or PowerShell/CIM with -ComputerName) includes a remote target and queries system identity/inventory outside the authorized management baseline

analytics.name: Analytic 2148
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an account on an ICS Linux host invoking SSH, SNMP, or another remote-management utility with a non-local target to query remote system identity, hardware, operating-system, or inventory information outside the approved management baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

tuning.description: IP allowlist of legitimate sources for device identification queries.
Accounts with documented system administration responsibilities.
Time window within which multiple enumeration commands are considered a systematic reconnaissance sequence.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; SSH/SNMP/remote-management command includes a remote target host and queries system identity/inventory from an account outside the authorized management set

analytics.name: Analytic 2186
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) GET requests targeting system information Object Identifiers (OIDs) from a source not in the approved Network Management System (NMS) Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnet, directed at Industrial Control System (ICS) server or device IPs. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

Time window within which multiple enumeration commands are considered a systematic reconnaissance sequence.

log_sources.name: networkdevice:snmp
log_sources.channel: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) GET to system info OID from source not in approved Network Management System (NMS) Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnet

analytics.name: Analytic 2249
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol requests targeting device identification and system metadata objects from a source not in the approved control server list, specifically aimed at device metadata rather than process values. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
